title: Have a project in mind?
description: Tell us what you're building. We'll help you figure out the right approach — scope, timeline and what it realistically takes.
responseTime: We usually reply within one business day.
_note: {{site.*}} and {{social.*}} tokens are resolved at load time by assets/js/data.js — never paste an email, phone number or profile URL in here, point at the one in site.json / social.json instead.

assurances.text: Your details are used only to reply to this enquiry.
You get a written scope before anything is committed.
No sales sequence, no follow-up spam.

form.successMessage: Thanks for reaching out. We'll review the details and get back to you within one business day.
form.errorMessage: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again, or email us directly.
form.note: The endpoint should be a server-side handler (PHP, Node, Laravel route, form service). Never place API keys, SMTP credentials or tokens in this file — it is served to the browser.
